standard_prerequisites.use: The scheme case: henselian local rings of U and V = U x_{Spec(A)} Spec(A^) at v have isomorphic completions.

core_obligations: Choose an elementary etale neighbourhood (U, u) -> (X, p) as in the decent-spaces lemma; set V = U x_X Y, which equals U x_{Spec(A)} Spec(A^), and v = (u, q).
The henselian local ring O_{X,p}^h is identified with O_{U,u}^h and O_{Y,q}^h with O_{V,v}^h by etale localization of henselian rings.
Apply the scheme-case lemma to U and V to get the isomorphism on completions.
proof_roadmap: Etale neighbourhood selection; henselian ring identification under etale localization; scheme-case application.
difficulty_reason: A short proof whose content is the explicit etale replacement (neighbourhood, base change, point) that makes the scheme lemma applicable; not a bare 'immediately' since the reduction path is written out.
